activities.activity_phrase: provides scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo
activities.source_sentence: General We provide scheduled air transportation for passengers and cargo throughout the United States ("U.S.") and around the world.

activities.activity_phrase: operates hub, international gateway and key airports
activities.source_sentence: Our route network is centered around a system of hub, international gateway and key airports that we operate in Amsterdam, Atlanta, Boston, Detroit, London-Heathrow, Los Angeles, Minneapolis-St. Paul, New York-LaGuardia, New York-JFK, Paris-Charles de Gaulle, Salt Lake City, Seattle and Tokyo-Narita.

activities.activity_phrase: gathers and distributes traffic from markets
activities.source_sentence: Each of these operations includes flights that gather and distribute traffic from markets in the geographic region surrounding the hub or gateway to domestic and international cities and to other hubs or gateways.

activities.activity_phrase: operates joint ventures with foreign carriers
activities.source_sentence: We currently operate three joint ventures with foreign carriers.

activities.activity_phrase: has strategic equity investments in Grupo Aeroméxico, S.A.B. de C.V. and GOL Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes, S.A.
activities.source_sentence: We have separate strategic equity investments in Grupo Aeroméxico, S.A.B. de C.V., the parent company of Aeroméxico, and in GOL Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes, S.A., the parent company of VRG Linhas Aéreas (operating as GOL), and an exclusive commercial relationship with each air carrier.

activities.activity_phrase: has established a joint venture relating to an airframe maintenance, repair and overhaul operation
activities.source_sentence: In addition to our commercial cooperation arrangements for passenger service with Aeroméxico, we and Aeroméxico have established a joint venture relating to an airframe maintenance, repair and overhaul operation located in Queretaro, Mexico.

activities.activity_phrase: acquired shares of China Eastern
activities.source_sentence: We have also acquired shares of China Eastern and entered into a commercial agreement with them to expand our relationship and better connect the networks of the two airlines.

activities.activity_phrase: is a member of the SkyTeam global airline alliance
activities.source_sentence: In addition to our marketing alliance agreements with individual foreign airlines, we are a member of the SkyTeam global airline alliance.

activities.activity_phrase: controls scheduling, pricing, reservations, ticketing and seat inventories for regional carriers' flights
activities.source_sentence: Our contractual agreements with regional carriers primarily are capacity purchase arrangements, under which we control the scheduling, pricing, reservations, ticketing and seat inventories for the regional carriers' flights operating under our “DL” designator code.

activities.activity_phrase: purchases aircraft fuel
activities.source_sentence: General We purchase most of our aircraft fuel under contracts that establish the price based on various market indices and therefore do not provide material protection against price increases or assure the availability of our fuel supplies.

activities.activity_phrase: exchanges non-jet fuel products with third parties for jet fuel
activities.source_sentence: Monroe exchanges substantially all the non-jet fuel products the refinery produces with third parties for jet fuel consumed in our airline operations.

activities.activity_phrase: utilize different contract and commodity types in a hedging program and test their economic effectiveness against financial targets
activities.source_sentence: We utilize different contract and commodity types in this program and frequently test their economic effectiveness against our financial targets.

activities.activity_phrase: monitor the hedge portfolio and rebalance the portfolio based on market conditions
activities.source_sentence: We closely monitor the hedge portfolio and rebalance the portfolio based on market conditions, which may result in locking in gains or losses on hedge contracts prior to their settlement dates .

activities.activity_phrase: allow program members to earn mileage credit for travel awards by flying on Delta, its regional carriers and other participating airlines
activities.source_sentence: The SkyMiles program allows program members to earn mileage credit for travel awards by flying on Delta, its regional carriers and other participating airlines.

activities.activity_phrase: allow mileage credit to be earned by using certain services offered by program participants, such as credit card companies, hotels and car rental agencies
activities.source_sentence: Mileage credit may also be earned by using certain services offered by program participants, such as credit card companies, hotels and car rental agencies.

activities.activity_phrase: allow individuals and companies to purchase mileage credits
activities.source_sentence: In addition, individuals and companies may purchase mileage credits.

activities.activity_phrase: redeem SkyMiles program mileage credits for air travel on Delta and participating airlines, for membership in Delta Sky Clubs and for other program participant awards
activities.source_sentence: SkyMiles program mileage credits can be redeemed for air travel on Delta and participating airlines, for membership in our Delta Sky Clubs ® and for other program participant awards.

activities.activity_phrase: generate cargo revenues in domestic and international markets through the use of cargo space on regularly scheduled passenger aircraft
activities.source_sentence: We generate cargo revenues in domestic and international markets through the use of cargo space on regularly scheduled passenger aircraft.

activities.activity_phrase: provide aircraft charters, aircraft management and programs allowing members to purchase flight time by the hour
activities.source_sentence: Our private jet operations, Delta Private Jets, provides aircraft charters, aircraft management and programs allowing members to purchase flight time by the hour.

activities.activity_phrase: offer five distinct travel experiences, which include premium amenities and services in Delta One, First Class and Delta Comfort+ while Main Cabin and Basic Economy options allow customers to match the level of service with their preferences
activities.source_sentence: We will offer five distinct travel experiences, which include premium amenities and services in Delta One TM , First Class and Delta Comfort+ TM while Main Cabin and Basic Economy options allow customers to match the level of service with their preferences.

activities.activity_phrase: sells tickets through travel agents
activities.source_sentence: Many of our tickets are sold by travel agents, and fares are subject to commissions, overrides and discounts paid to travel agents, brokers and wholesalers.

activities.activity_phrase: requests extension of international route authorities
activities.source_sentence: We request extension of these authorities when and as appropriate.

activities.activity_phrase: complies with EPA aircraft emission standards
activities.source_sentence: Our aircraft comply with existing EPA standards as applicable by engine design date.

activities.activity_phrase: monitors and evaluates potential impact of legislative and regulatory developments regarding emissions
activities.source_sentence: We are monitoring and evaluating the potential impact of such legislative and regulatory developments.

activities.activity_phrase: reduces fuel needs of aircraft fleet through retirement of older, less fuel efficient aircraft and replacement with newer, more fuel efficient aircraft
activities.source_sentence: We have reduced the fuel needs of our aircraft fleet through the retirement of older, less fuel efficient aircraft and replacement with newer, more fuel efficient aircraft.

activities.activity_phrase: implements fuel saving procedures in flight and ground support operations
activities.source_sentence: In addition, we have implemented fuel saving procedures in our flight and ground support operations that further reduce carbon emissions.

activities.activity_phrase: supports efforts to develop alternative fuels
activities.source_sentence: We are also supporting efforts to develop alternative fuels and efforts to modernize the air traffic control system in the U.S., as part of our efforts to reduce our emissions and minimize our impact on the environment.

activities.activity_phrase: supports efforts to modernize the air traffic control system in the U.S.
activities.source_sentence: We are also supporting efforts to develop alternative fuels and efforts to modernize the air traffic control system in the U.S., as part of our efforts to reduce our emissions and minimize our impact on the environment.

activities.activity_phrase: operates the Trainer refinery
activities.source_sentence: Monroe's operation of the Trainer refinery is subject to numerous environmental laws and extensive regulations, including those relating to the discharge of materials into the environment, waste management, pollution prevention measures and greenhouse gas emissions.

activities.activity_phrase: purchases RINs in the secondary market or obtains a waiver from the EPA
activities.source_sentence: Because the refinery operated by Monroe does not blend renewable fuels, it must purchase its entire RINs requirement in the secondary market or obtain a waiver from the EPA.

activities.activity_phrase: investigates and remediates soil and/or ground water contamination at current or former leaseholds at several domestic airports
activities.source_sentence: To address this contamination, we have a program in place to investigate and, if appropriate, remediate these sites.

activities.activity_phrase: makes available a portion of international aircraft under the CRAF Program
activities.source_sentence: We have agreed to make available under the CRAF Program a portion of our international aircraft during the contract period ending September 30, 2016.
